استتفهنا (form X)
# اِسْتَتْفَهْنَا (istatfahnā) /is.tat.fah.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اُسْتُتْفِهْنَا (ustutfihnā) /us.tut.fih.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
